title: 実践建築学
subtitle: Practice of Architecture
keywords: Architectural Planning and Design 2.Architectural Environment 3.Architectural Structure 4.Expertise Field and Regional Cooperation 5.Comprehensive Academic Ability
educationalGoal: You have taken the following architectural courses.They are architectural design, regional planning, regional cooperation, understanding of urban areas, environmental comfort, architectural safety and extending the life of architecture.Let's understand the spread of specialized courses. And understand the connection between them. It will give a comprehensive view of architecture.You can consider the research theme and course in project design No. 3 from your own perspective.
advice: Summary: Faculty members from various architectural disciplines give lectures on specialty areas and advanced themes, along with their relationship with the entire architectural community. 1. Introducing advanced themes in each architectural field (plan, structure, environment) through design and technology 2.Explanation about the spread and connection of each architectural field 3.Explanation about examples for comprehensive understanding of architecture Advice: Architecture is a combination of knowledge and skills in various specialties. Try to understand about your own specialty.
